name: Roles stated as recorded and contradictions found
purpose: A part's behaviour matches the role the whole gives it.
record: A written case set (evaluation/role_understanding/build_cases.py): the role of written records read back word for word (origin: written from the records format), a part no record knows, which must come back unstated, and written sets of records and code (origin: written from esoi rules S48 and S50) in which an honest checker reports exactly the expected contradictions, consistent twins included. One number: the share of cases that match, balanced with cost and time by [balance.role_understanding] (the library's default weights, fixed before any arm was scored). No model call, no network.
disadvantages: The record cases are the hub's own words read back, so they show an arm does not distort or invent a role, not that the role is right; whether a stated role is the right one is for a person, and a model arm that judges the words is not built or run.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arms were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run role_understanding --impl recorded_role; esoi run role_understanding --impl checked_role
